Q00362_BardsMandolin/30958-01.html.text: Galion: A flute? Wait a moment, let me check... Ah, yes, here it is! A flute made of horn, imported from Avella. It's quite expensive but has an exquisite tone!

Q00362_BardsMandolin/30958-02.html.text: Galion: How is my old friend Trader Woodrow? I feel I know him well although we have only spoken by letter...
